preconditions.description: The number of water tanks n must be between 2 and 50.
The total width increase k must be between 0 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= cij <= 10**6 for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each pipe width cij must be a non-negative integer not exceeding 1,000,000.
There are no pipes from a tank to itself, i.e., cii must be 0 for all i.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum amount of water that can be transmitted from the main tank to the sewer tank per unit of time.
